title: DPIIT startup recognition
summary: Recognition as a startup by DPIIT, applied for on the National Single Window System (NSWS) after incorporation.

authority.name: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

eligibility.text: Incorporated as a Private Limited Company or registered as a Partnership Firm, LLP or Cooperative Society.
Turnover less than INR 200 Crores (INR 300 Crores for DeepTech startups) in any of the previous financial years.
A startup for up to 10 years (20 years for DeepTech) from the date of incorporation, working towards innovation or improvement of products, services or processes.

sources.title: Startup DPIIT Recognition Application on National Single Window System
India's National Single Window System for Business Approvals | NSWS
Startup DPIIT Recognition Application on National Single Window System: A Guide

steps.title: Apply for DPIIT startup recognition
steps.description: Create an account on NSWS, add the approval 'Registration as a Startup' to the NSWS dashboard, fill the application form and apply.

documents.name: PAN of the entity (validated on NSWS)

outputs.name: DPIIT Certificate of Recognition (also on DigiLocker)

fee.note: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry does not charge any fee for the DPIIT Certificate of Recognition.

officialSla.wording: The certificate of recognition is issued typically within 2 working days upon successful submission of the application.

review.note: Checked 2026-09-28, Startup India FAQ Q7: "The certificate of recognition is issued typically within 2 working days upon successful submission of the application."
